== Attacks ==
* '''Pre attack''' sound plays during the attack animation (at a 10% lower pitch).
** <sm2>Brewmaster preattack1.mp3</sm2> Pre attack 1
** <sm2>Brewmaster preattack2.mp3</sm2> Pre attack 2
** <sm2>Brewmaster preattack3.mp3</sm2> Pre attack 3

* '''Impact''' sounds play when the attack successfully hits a target. Each attack uses one main impact sound and one blade ring sound
** <sm2>Monkey King attack1.mp3</sm2> Main impact 1
** <sm2>Monkey King attack2.mp3</sm2> Main impact 2
** <sm2>Monkey King attack3.mp3</sm2> Main impact 3
** <sm2>Shared large blade ring1.mp3</sm2> Additional impact 1 (80% vol, 20% lower pitch)
** <sm2>Shared large blade ring2.mp3</sm2> Additional impact 2 (80% vol, 20% lower pitch)
** <sm2>Shared large blade ring3.mp3</sm2> Additional impact 3 (80% vol, 20% lower pitch)
** <sm2>Shared large blade ring4.mp3</sm2> Additional impact 4 (80% vol, 20% lower pitch)

== Abilities ==
=== Boundless Strike ===
* Pre cast sound plays on Monkey King at the beginning of the cast animation.
** <sm2>Boundless Strike pre cast 1.mp3</sm2> Pre cast 1
** <sm2>Boundless Strike pre cast 2.mp3</sm2> Pre cast 2
** <sm2>Boundless Strike pre cast 3.mp3</sm2> Pre cast 3
* Cast sound plays on 2 locations upon cast, on Monkey King and at the tip of the Staff.
** <sm2>Boundless Strike cast 1.mp3</sm2> Cast 1
** <sm2>Boundless Strike cast 2.mp3</sm2> Cast 2
** <sm2>Boundless Strike cast 3.mp3</sm2> Cast 3
* <sm2>Boundless Strike.mp3</sm2> Full sound example.

''[[Staff of Gun-Yu]]''
* Replace the default cast sounds.
** <sm2>Staff of Gun-Yu Boundless Strike cast 1.mp3</sm2> Cast 1
** <sm2>Staff of Gun-Yu Boundless Strike cast 2.mp3</sm2> Cast 2
** <sm2>Staff of Gun-Yu Boundless Strike cast 3.mp3</sm2> Cast 3
* <sm2>Staff of Gun-Yu Boundless Strike.mp3</sm2> Full sound example.

=== Tree Dance ===
* Cast sound plays on Monkey King upon cast.
** <sm2>Tree Dance cast 1.mp3</sm2> Cast 1
** <sm2>Tree Dance cast 2.mp3</sm2> Cast 2
** <sm2>Tree Dance cast 3.mp3</sm2> Cast 3
* Target sound plays on the targeted tree upon reaching it (70% vol).
** <sm2>Tree Dance target 1.mp3</sm2> Target 1
** <sm2>Tree Dance target 2.mp3</sm2> Target 2
** <sm2>Tree Dance target 3.mp3</sm2> Target 3
* <sm2>Tree Dance.mp3</sm2> Full sound example.

=== Primal Spring ===
* <sm2>Primal Spring cast.mp3</sm2> Cast sound plays on Monkey King upon cast and lasts as long as the channeling does.
* Jump sound plays on Monkey King upon jumping off the tree after the channeling.
** <sm2>Tree Dance cast 1.mp3</sm2> Cast 1
** <sm2>Tree Dance cast 2.mp3</sm2> Cast 2
** <sm2>Tree Dance cast 3.mp3</sm2> Cast 3
* <sm2>Primal Spring impact.mp3</sm2> Impact sound plays upon landing at the targeted area.
* <sm2>Primal Spring target.mp3</sm2> Target sound plays on each hit enemy.
* <sm2>Primal Spring.mp3</sm2> Full sound example.

''[[Great Sage's Reckoning]]''
* Additional impact sound plays together with the default impact sound (Rumble in the Deep only).
** <sm2>Rip Tide cast1.mp3</sm2> Cast 1
** <sm2>Rip Tide cast2.mp3</sm2> Cast 2
** <sm2>Rip Tide cast3.mp3</sm2> Cast 3
* <sm2>Great Sage's Reckoning Rumble in the Deep Primal Spring.mp3</sm2> Full sound example.

* <sm2>Jingu Mastery proc.mp3</sm2> Proc sound plays whenever the buff is placed on Monkey King.
* <sm2>Jingu Mastery.mp3</sm2> Sound example together with attacks.

=== Mischief ===
* <sm2>Mischief.mp3</sm2> Plays on Monkey King upon cast (50% vol).

=== Revert Form ===
* <sm2>Revert Form.mp3</sm2> Plays on Monkey King upon cast (50% vol).

=== Wukong's Command ===
* <sm2>Wukong's Command pre cast.mp3</sm2> Pre cast sound plays on Monkey King at the beginning of the cast animation.
* <sm2>Wukong's Command cast.mp3</sm2> Cast sound plays on Monkey King upon cast.
